title: Prometheus research package manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a research package directory. This schema is the single machine contract for the manifest; references/research-package-spec.md is its normative prose. export-package.sh writes it, scripts/check-research-package.sh validates it in shell, and prometheus-research validates it in Rust before research_export returns. Every field is required so a manifest cannot silently omit state; nullable fields say null explicitly.

format_version.description: Version of this manifest contract. 2.0.0 is the first schema-validated version; 1.x manifests predate the schema and do not validate.

package_id.description: The package directory name: <slug>-<yyyymmdd>-<4hex>. The slug is one to five lowercase hyphenated words derived from the query by shared/scripts/lib/slug.sh; the pattern enforces the five-word limit.

job_id.description: The run identifier the driver or daemon minted (daemon form: job-<epoch>-<uuid8>). Distinct from package_id; recorded so daemon checkpoints and packages can be joined.

scale.description: direct: the planner emitted fewer than three sub-questions and the driver ran stages 01, 02, 03, 05, 09, 10 with no subagents. full: all stages for the depth.

completed_at.description: null while the run is in progress or blocked before stage 10.

stages_completed.description: Stages whose required artifacts validated, in execution order. An array, not a count, so --resume can read it.

confidence.description: Credibility-weighted mean of claim confidences from stage 09; null when stage 09 did not run.

verification_status.description: Package-level label, derived from claim labels by the rule in okf-research-format.md. verified: every critical claim is verified. partial: any critical claim is blocked or inferred, or the adversarial review returned CRITICAL, or the Feynman gate was skipped. unverified: stage 05 did not run.

verification_verdict.description: The provenance sidecar verdict, copied so the manifest and <slug>.provenance.md cannot disagree.

adversarial_review_used.description: true when the driver dispatched adversarial-review on report.md before stage 10; false when the judge was unavailable or the run was direct scale.

model_routing.description: Model class used per stage as resolved by liter-llm-bridge; a stage that did not run is absent.

sensitivity.description: Rank sensitivity written by stage 05 (scripts/score-sources.py): every source re-ranked under four alternate weight vectors, each rank classified stable | sensitive | volatile; see research-package-spec.md, sensitivity.json. Present when stage 05 ran.
